features.name: Mellon Park Walled Garden
features.description: Mellon Park Walled Garden is the restored formal garden south of Fifth Avenue, centered on historic brick walls, limestone steps, Edmond R. Amateis' fountain and Janet Zweig's 150-light memorial recreating Pittsburgh's night sky at Ann Katharine Seamans' birth.
